references.text: The description of the holy incense that was to be used in the tabernacle, which is what the golden bowl was filled with
Golden bowls are mentioned as part of the equipment for the tabernacle
The first time the golden bowl with incense is mentioned is in chapter 7, showing the pattern of the offerings from the tribal leaders
The summary of all twelve golden bowls filled with incense from the tribal leaders
Golden bowls filled with incense represent the prayers of the saints in the heavenly sanctuary
Incense and golden bowls are used in the heavenly worship service, which points back to the service of the tabernacle
